notes: Suno times refer to the recorded song, not to David's talk.
Ranges are creative correspondences, not quotes or direct endorsements. Chalked ideas are distinguished from David's discourse.
The line ledger scene_pedigree_v5.csv contains 85 primary sequential windows; timing_v2.json retains all 94 machine-detected line cues and 568 word entries.
The English/Italian SALE visual is the video maker's invented illustrative example, not something attributed to David.

links.lyric: You said yes / I said yes / Same word, different worlds
links.source_theme: Same instructions or agreement can mask different priorities.
links.relation: Adapted opening situation; the globe and English SALE/Italian sale imagery are original artistic examples.

links.lyric: I was racing for the finish / You were asking who's affected
links.source_theme: Speed/efficiency compared with consultation and who bears consequences.
links.relation: Close conceptual paraphrase in the song; no direct quote asserted.

links.lyric: Not a failure of the language / Just a choice we hadn't made
links.source_theme: Genuine priorities disagreement rather than simple misunderstanding.

links.lyric: Back to the drawing board / Trust is giving room to move
links.source_theme: Reopen deliberation and retain genuine delegated autonomy while making revisions possible.
links.relation: Creator's theoretical synthesis; not presented as David's statement.

links.lyric: How soon do we know we're drifting? / Who can change what happens next? / Who holds the eraser?
links.source_theme: Detection latency and meaningful intervention authority; erase/revision rights.
links.relation: Two distinct intellectual sources brought into dialogue.

links.lyric: Your compass isn't my compass / Still our roads can share a mile
links.source_theme: Partially overlapping values can still permit bounded cooperation.
links.relation: Original metaphor developed from the discussion.

links.lyric: Everyone can read the signpost / Not everyone is who it's for
links.source_theme: Read permission and addressivity do not coincide; reader is not always intended addressee.
links.relation: Directly grounded in creator's submitted theoretical framework.

links.lyric: Tomorrow brings a different world / A warning isn't power
links.source_theme: The plan/goal can change; alerting does not grant standing to intervene.

links.lyric: Back to the drawing board / Call the whole room in / Who holds the eraser?
links.source_theme: Realignment is a social feedback/governance loop; return to the forum and restore evitability.

links.lyric: Two agents checked the sent mail ... / Till we checked it with the record
links.source_theme: A mistaken open-decision assumption arose from checking sent mail while overlooking another record; error propagated into a morning plan.
links.relation: Retains recognizable anecdote; animation elaborates it with archive and handoff sketches.

links.lyric: Faster, faster ... / You can name a human captain
links.source_theme: AIs may revise and act faster than humans can evaluate; a nominal supervisor may have little actionable control; board as communication-rate governor.
links.relation: David supplies speed-asymmetry challenge; Chalked supplies governor metaphor.

links.lyric: What does being in charge mean here? / Who can read it? / Who can write it? / Who can stop it?
links.source_theme: Authority to intervene vs read/write/erase permissions and legitimate forum.

links.lyric: No promise we can solve tomorrow / But we can count the time to notice
links.source_theme: Study correction capabilities now, without asserting this solves future superintelligence alignment.

links.lyric: Back to the drawing board / Trust is giving room to move
links.source: Chalked §4 + Ikigai creator report + David conclusion
links.source_theme: Retain meaningful agency by reopening decisions while alternatives remain; preserve cooperation through revision.

links.lyric: You said yes / I said yes / We can trust and change the plan
links.source_theme: Return to a similar surface with altered choices and preserved trust.
links.relation: Original lyrical resolution, not quoted from source.
